verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic search runtime, so tuning index parameters is a fair question for it, but the evidence never mentions HNSW graph settings, selectable index types, or recall/latency/memory trade-off controls. The documented knobs are the hybrid `alpha` blend and `min_score` filtering, which are query-time retrieval controls rather than index parameters, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
